candidates.why_relevant: Individual profiles (e.g. Halkbank AD Skopje executives) often show a parent-group transfer weeks before any press release; also the primary channel for MK bank hiring signals.
candidates.legal_status: ToS prohibits scraping; manual review or licensed API only
candidates.suggested_collection_method: manual analyst review of named executives; no automated scraping
queries_used: Halkbank AD Skopje Türkiye Halk Bankası subsidiary North Macedonia general manager appointment KAP

negative_findings.description: Targeted mk search for the head of the NBRNM Payment Systems Directorate ('НБРСМ директор дирекција платни системи назначен') returned only regulatory/legal documents and bank customer pages, no announcement naming a director of the Дирекција за платни системи.
negative_findings.result_summary: NBRNM does not appear to publish sub-Council directorate head appointments in an indexed, searchable way; unit-head identity likely only inferable from conference speaker lists, annual reports and LinkedIn.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale treats a new payment-systems director as a leading indicator, but this specific signal has no reliable primary channel — collection must fall back to indirect proxies.

negative_findings.description: Automated fetches of https://www.nbrm.mk/organizatsiona_struktura.nspx and https://www.sobranie.mk/ both returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as a bot-defence hypothesis, NOT as dead sources — both domains appear repeatedly and currently in search indexes. Recorded as blocked=true with blocker_type=bot_protection_suspected.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The two most important primary channels in this cell may need browser-context or header-realistic collection rather than plain HTTP; a naive crawler would silently produce zero coverage.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated public register of appointments/dismissals ('регистар на именувања') for the financial sector was found; MISA/МИОА was not confirmed to publish a searchable public-sector appointment register relevant to banking supervision.
negative_findings.result_summary: Appointment data is scattered across Службен весник PDFs, Assembly decisions and Government session releases; no single structured feed exists.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must be multi-source and reconciliation-based rather than relying on one register.

negative_findings.description: Службен весник's full internet edition ('СЛУЖБЕН ВЕСНИК НА РСМ ИНТЕРНЕТ ИЗДАНИЕ') is a paid subscription; only a free-access subset page and individually linked issue PDFs were observed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Free issue PDFs exist under /Issues/<hash>.pdf and a 'бесплатен пристап' page, but systematic historical search may require subscription.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Budget/licensing decision needed before treating the gazette as a complete backfill source.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Macedonian for a Central Registry bulletin or feed that publishes newly registered changes (an 'објава на упис' gazette-style list) analogous to other countries' register bulletins.
negative_findings.result_summary: No such public change-event bulletin or feed was found. CRM appears to expose only per-entity lookups (free basic profile, paid current-status and history certificates) and a contract-based distribution system.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means change detection for this cell must be built as periodic per-entity polling of a known watchlist, not as consumption of an event stream — which raises cost and creates a detection lag.

negative_findings.description: Searched for a documented public API or open-data dump of the Трговски регистар (bulk officers/representatives data).
negative_findings.result_summary: Found only the fee-based Интернет дистрибутивен систем (contract + prepayment) and a free per-entity web lookup. No evidence of an unauthenticated machine-readable API was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated collection likely requires either a commercial CRM data agreement or careful form-driven collection; plan budget and legal review accordingly.

negative_findings.description: Attempted direct fetch of the NBRSM e-money institutions register page.
negative_findings.result_summary: HTTP 403 Forbidden. The URL is referenced from search indexes and other NBRSM pages, so this is treated as a bot-defence hypothesis, not evidence the page is dead. Recorded as unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: NBRSM registers are the pointer that defines the monitored entity population; the collector will need a browser-grade fetch path for nbrm.mk.

negative_findings.description: Looked for a still-operating court commercial register ('судски регистар') holding signatory changes separately from CRM.
negative_findings.result_summary: No evidence found of a live parallel court register for signatory/board changes; the trade register function appears consolidated in the Central Registry, with courts relevant only via appeals against registration decisions (жалба против решение за упис).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief assumed a distinct court-register layer; if consolidation is confirmed, effort should concentrate on CRM plus the gazette rather than on court archives.

negative_findings.description: Searched for a full-text search interface over Службен весник issues that would let a collector query for appointment decisions by keyword.
negative_findings.result_summary: Subscription and free-access pages were found, but no confirmed public full-text search endpoint was identified in these searches.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Gazette monitoring may have to be issue-PDF ingestion plus local indexing rather than server-side search.

negative_findings.description: No standalone, formally constituted fintech or blockchain association with published elected governance was found for North Macedonia. The closest bodies are AFD (Асоцијација на финансиски друштва), which frames itself as covering fintech/non-bank financial services, and the informal Fintech.mk community, which has no elected board.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched in both mk and en for a fintech/blockchain association; results returned AFD, an informal community, a FINKI Fintech Academy, and a Bulgarian fintech association as noise. No MK fintech association site confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumes association governance elections are a leadership signal; for the fintech sub-sector that signal does not exist in MK, so fintech actor enumeration must fall back on regulator registers (NBRM payment-institution register) and MASIT membership rather than association directories.

negative_findings.finding_type: structural change not reflected in expectations
negative_findings.description: The Chamber of Commerce of North Macedonia (mchamber.mk) does not currently list a banking association among its published associations/groups. Historical material shows a Здружение на банкарството existed within the Chamber (Dr. Gligor Bishev is referenced as its chairman) and MBA's own Executive Secretary is described as a former Secretary of the Banking Association at the Chamber of Commerce.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetching the Chamber's association index returned association forms and an ICT association, but no banking association; only a non-bank financial companies group (Групација 25) covers finance.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Banking-sector association governance in MK has migrated from the Chamber to the standalone MBA. Monitoring should therefore centre on mba.mk, with mchamber.mk retained only for non-bank finance, ICT and cross-sector groups — a routine that watches the Chamber for bank leadership signals will systematically miss them.

negative_findings.description: MBA does not publish an explicit enumerated list of member banks; the About page defines membership by rule (all banks and savings houses licensed under the Law on Banks) plus two named non-bank members, KIBS AD Skopje and Macedonian Credit Bureau AD Skopje.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetched mba.mk/w/mk/za-nas/ — membership stated as a rule rather than a list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The member population must be reconstructed from the NBRM licensed-bank register rather than from the association, meaning MBA cannot serve as the canonical member map its cell rationale anticipates — though the two named non-bank members (clearing house + credit bureau) are payments-infrastructure actors worth tracking in their own right.

negative_findings.description: No page was found naming the chairs of MBA's commissions (комисии) or the composition of the SKIBOR panel, nor any payments-specific committee chair at either MBA or the Chamber.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for комисија за платен промет претседател returned no current committee-chair page; MBA's navigation lists Комисии as a section but no chair names surfaced in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale's core hypothesis — that the payments committee chair reveals institutional weight — could not be validated for MK in this pass. A direct fetch of the MBA Комисии subpage is required before concluding the data does not exist.

negative_findings.description: Albanian-language association sources (OEMVP / Oda Ekonomike e Maqedonisë Veriperëndimore) were identified but not searched systematically, because the run's declared languages are mk and en only.
negative_findings.result_summary: An Albanian-term query returned the chamber's existence but no member or board data.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A meaningful share of MK business-association activity, including banking-adjacent membership, is conducted in Albanian; excluding sq creates a structural blind spot in the actor map.

negative_findings.description: Direct fetch of the ESJN Public Access homepage (https://e-nabavki.gov.mk/PublicAccess/home.aspx) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.
negative_findings.result_summary: No page content retrieved. Treated as bot-defence on a live portal, not as a dead source — the domain is heavily linked from BJN, MoF and news sources and its subpages appear in current search indexes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important source in this cell will need a headless browser or session-aware fetcher rather than a plain HTTP client; plan collection tooling accordingly and re-verify liveness in the deterministic pass.

negative_findings.description: No specific MK public tender or award notice for a payment gateway / card acceptance / POS deployment could be surfaced through web search in either language.
negative_findings.result_summary: mk queries ('ПОС терминали' јавна набавка, набавка на банкарски услуги) returned the portal, ministry procurement index pages and commercial bank POS marketing pages, not individual notices. en queries returned donor/aggregator pages only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ESJN notice pages appear to be poorly indexed by general search engines (dynamic ASP.NET grids), so keyword web search is NOT a viable discovery channel for individual notices — collection must go through the portal's own search/export or the open-data extracts.

negative_findings.description: No MK-specific commercial tender-aggregator brand (e.g. a 'tenderi.mk' style local subscription service) was confirmed to exist.
negative_findings.result_summary: The mk query for local aggregators returned only official .gov.mk portals plus Montenegro's cejn.gov.me; only international aggregators (DevelopmentAid, GTBC, SellToState/Hook) were found covering MK.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If a local-language aggregator exists it would be a cheap normalised feed; its apparent absence means the collection burden falls on the official portal and on international aggregators with weaker MK depth.

negative_findings.description: No published award notice naming key experts or a contract project manager on an MK banking/payments public contract was located within this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only one concrete tender dossier PDF (Customs, 2017) and one named donor consultancy role (UNDP IC 868-2026 National Sustainable Finance & Institutional Specialist) were found at the named-person/named-role level.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The named-people signal this cell promises is real but sits inside PDF dossiers and appeal files, not in search-indexed HTML — extraction design must be PDF-first.

negative_findings.description: No public MK-language announcement of a Netcetera / G+D Netcetera Skopje managing-director or country-manager appointment was found, despite searching MK appointment vocabulary ('нов директор', 'именуван') alongside English 'appointed'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search returned only the generic careers page, Glassdoor location/review pages and unrelated Macedonian public figures. No press release, no MK trade-press item.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leadership-move signals for the largest MK payments delivery centre are apparently not published locally; the A5 leadership-move stream for vendors will have to lean on LinkedIn profile changes (ToS-restricted) or trade press, not corporate newsrooms — a structural blind spot to plan around.

negative_findings.description: InterWorks (Bitola) publicly states a deliberate policy of NOT disclosing client references, citing protection of clients against social-engineering attacks.
negative_findings.result_summary: MK tech-press profile confirms the non-disclosure culture; no client list or bank reference is published by the company.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's core assumption — that the supplier side is where private-bank relationships leak — fails for security-conscious integrators. Absence of a bank on an integrator's reference page must never be scored as absence of a relationship; for these actors only hiring ads and press interviews are usable.

negative_findings.description: No public MK vendor/partner directory for payment-terminal (POS/ATM) distribution or authorised-reseller programmes in North Macedonia was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: MK queries using 'партнер програма', 'дистрибутер', 'платежни терминали', 'овластен' returned processor and bank pages, not any manufacturer partner-locator listing MK resellers.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Terminal-estate supply is a key capacity indicator for a payments vendor; without a partner directory, the MK terminal-distribution channel remains unmapped and must be reconstructed from tender documents, bank PDFs and company-registry activity codes.

negative_findings.description: Direct searches for MK bank IT suppliers/system integrators from the BANK side (Komercijalna banka, Stopanska banka + 'добавувач', 'систем интегратор', 'имплементација') produced no supplier disclosure at all.
negative_findings.result_summary: Results were only the banks' own retail product pages, Wikipedia entries and e-banking FAQs — confirming the cell rationale that private MK banks publish no procurement or vendor information.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Empirically validates that pointer/supplier-side collection is the ONLY viable route for MK vendor-relationship intelligence, and justifies prioritising vendor newsrooms and bank technical PDFs over any bank-side procurement monitoring.

negative_findings.description: Seavus, ULTRA and Neotel returned no substantive banking/fintech client-reference or MK-banking careers content in either language in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Combined vendor-cluster query returned material only for Nextsense; the other three named seeds produced nothing about banking clients or MK payments hiring.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Three of the cell's seed actors remain unmapped; either they are not materially active in MK banking delivery or their traces need per-company targeted crawling of their own domains rather than search-engine discovery.

negative_findings.description: Several vendor root domains in this slice (sorsix.com, interworks.com.mk, duna.mk root, ecommerce.mk root, faktor.mk root, kariera.mk root, it.mk/kariera) were inferred from search-result metadata or subpage URLs rather than fetched in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs are recorded with the confidence scores shown; liveness is explicitly NOT claimed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must resolve these before they are promoted to a monitored source list; a failed fetch on any of them should be treated as a hypothesis (bot defence / redirect), not as a dead source.

negative_findings.description: No 'банкар на годината' (Banker of the Year) individual award appears to exist for North Macedonia. Searches in Macedonian for 'банкар на годината' and 'менаџер на годината' in the financial sector returned only institution-level awards (The Banker 'Банка на годината', Global Finance 'Најдобра банка во Македонија', both repeatedly won by Комерцијална банка).
negative_findings.result_summary: Institution-level awards exist and are well covered; a person-level banking award was not found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Removes an assumed A5 signal channel — individual-leader recognition must instead be inferred from conference speaker rosters and association presidency lists, not from awards.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated CFA Society for North Macedonia was identified. Searches surfaced CFA Institute's society finder and CFA Society Greece (which serves the wider region), plus a low-credibility aggregator page (skopjedigitalbank.com) that should not be treated as evidence of a local chapter.
negative_findings.result_summary: MK CFA charterholders appear to have no national society; affiliation likely runs through a neighbouring society or directly to CFA Institute.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A hoped-for local roster of investment professionals with employer/title does not exist as a source; the cell must lean harder on ABIT, ACAMS and conference rosters.

negative_findings.description: No standalone, recurring MK-branded fintech/payments conference (i.e. a 'Skopje Fintech Summit' equivalent) was found. The functional equivalent is the AETM Regional eCommerce Conference plus the one-off hosting of EACHA's annual conference by KIBS. Searched in both mk and en.
negative_findings.result_summary: MK payments speaker signal is concentrated in e-commerce, ICT and regional (Tirana/Balkan) events rather than a domestic fintech conference.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection should not wait for a domestic fintech event; budget scraping effort toward AETM archives and regional forums instead.

negative_findings.description: No current Seavus-branded conference series was found; only a 2018 'Seavus CodeTalks Скопје' reference surfaced. Seavus is now part of a larger group and does not appear to run a public MK conference with a published speaker roster.
negative_findings.result_summary: The 'Seavus summit' element of the cell brief appears stale.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids sinking effort into a defunct event; MASIT and the AI Tech Summit are the live substitutes for vendor-side speaker signal.

negative_findings.description: MBA/NBRNM conference agendas exist but were located mainly via search snippets and one PDF path (nbrm.mk /content/Platni sistemi/List of participants.pdf); no consolidated 'events' index page on nbrm.mk or mba.mk was confirmed. Individual conference pages are .nspx and appear one-per-event.
negative_findings.result_summary: Agendas and participant lists are present but scattered; no single index to crawl.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must be a broad site crawl plus PDF discovery rather than a single feed; liveness of the participant-list PDF is unverified here.

negative_findings.description: The seed term 'Синдикат на работниците од финансиското работење / СФР' did not resolve to any existing organisation in mk-language search. The actually existing sector union is 'Синдикат на работниците од финансиските организации на Македонија' (СФОМ / SFOM), sfom.mk.
negative_findings.result_summary: Seed acronym СФР returned no matching union; СФОМ confirmed as the finance-sector union with bank and insurance member organisations.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream collection keyed on the seed name would return nothing; the glossary must use СФОМ / SFOM and 'финансиски организации', not 'финансиско работење'.

negative_findings.description: Targeted mk searches for bank branch closures and workforce reduction in North Macedonia ('затворање експозитури банка ... намалување број на вработени реструктуирање', 'технолошки вишок отпуштања банка') returned no MK bank-specific layoff or closure reporting — only generic bank pages and international (AI-driven) layoff coverage.
negative_findings.result_summary: No MK-specific restructuring/redundancy news surfaced in the first result pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Either MK bank restructuring is genuinely under-reported in open media, or it is announced only in per-bank notices and NBRSM statistics. Collection should therefore lean on branch-directory diffing and regulator tables rather than on news monitoring.

negative_findings.description: nbrm.mk returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain automated fetch of the banking-system reports index. Pages are indexed by search engines and appear live.
negative_findings.result_summary: 403 on https://www.nbrm.mk/izvieshtai_za_bankarskiot_sistiem_na_riepublika_makiedonija7b8cb632.nspx
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The regulator is the single most valuable source in this cell (employees and branches per bank). A collector needs a browser-context or UA-realistic fetch path; the 403 is a bot-defence hypothesis, not evidence the resource is dead.

negative_findings.description: No evidence found that СФОМ is affiliated to UNI Europa Finance / UNI Global Union, nor that it is one of the ~18 ССМ branch unions (the partial ССМ affiliate list retrieved does not include a finance union).
negative_findings.result_summary: English searches on UNI Europa + North Macedonia returned no MK finance affiliate; ССМ branch list excerpt showed no financial-sector union.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: СФОМ may be independent of both ССМ and the European federation, which changes where its bargaining news appears and which international channels can be used as a mirror. Needs direct confirmation from sfom.mk statute/profile pages.

negative_findings.description: No published State Labour Inspectorate annual report (годишен извештај за работа) PDF was located in this run; searches surfaced the inspectorate's mandate pages, the Labour Inspection Law and the separate State Administrative Inspectorate's report page instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: dit.gov.mk located, but its report archive was not reached; duinspektorat.mioa.gov.mk (a different inspectorate) surfaced instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Inspectorate statistics per sector are a key indirect indicator of labour conflict in banks; if reports are not published online, an FOI route must be planned instead.

negative_findings.description: Attempted to enumerate archived MK bank management pages via the Wayback CDX API (web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=kb.mk/*). WebFetch refused with 'Claude Code is unable to fetch from web.archive.org'.
negative_findings.result_summary: No archive captures could be enumerated from this environment. This is an egress/tooling restriction on my side, not evidence that the Wayback Machine or the captures are unavailable — the archive should be treated as live and high-value until a deterministic pass says otherwise.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Archive reconstruction is the cell's single most important capability for retroactively dating management changes; the collection pipeline must run CDX queries from an environment that permits web.archive.org.

negative_findings.description: Searched for Finextra coverage of North Macedonia payments-sector executive appointments.
negative_findings.result_summary: No Finextra item on an MK bank/PSP appointment surfaced; results returned legal guides (Multilaw, Mondaq), NBRNM payment-infrastructure pages and a payments-provider blog instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Finextra's regional desk appears not to cover MK personnel at all, so it should be deprioritised relative to SeeNews/bne for A5; MK payments personnel news likely only exists in mk-language and company-PR channels.

negative_findings.description: Searched for a Fitch or Moody's rating action on a named MK bank citing management turnover or governance.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the sovereign rating action (Fitch downgrade to 'BB') surfaced in open search; no bank-level rating action commentary for Komercijalna, Stopanska, Sparkasse or Halkbank Skopje was retrievable outside the agencies' login walls.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'ratings cite management turnover' hypothesis in the cell rationale is unconfirmed for MK: most MK banks may be unrated at entity level, with governance commentary appearing only at parent-group level (NLB, Erste, Halkbank TR). Collection should therefore target parent-group credit opinions, not MK-entity RACs.

negative_findings.description: Balkan Insight (balkaninsight.com) and Emerging Europe (emerging-europe.com) were probed via a combined query for MK banking/payments executive coverage.
negative_findings.result_summary: Neither outlet returned an MK banking/payments personnel item; results were dominated by bne IntelliNews. No evidence found that either outlet runs a banking-personnel desk for MK.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two of the six seed-named outlets appear not to be productive for this cell; effort should be reallocated to mk-language trade press (bankarstvo.mk) and SeeNews.

negative_findings.description: The Wayback-specific mk-language seed query ('Wayback Machine archive банка мк раководство менаџмент страница') was formulated and the mk archive vocabulary assembled, but could not be executed as an actual archive query because the archive host is unreachable from this environment.
negative_findings.result_summary: mk glossary for archive work established (раководство, Управен одбор, Надзорен одбор, органи на банката, менаџмент, за банката, соопштенија за јавност) but not validated against real captures.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The URL-path patterns to filter on in CDX must be validated empirically before the collector relies on them; MK banks use inconsistent slugs (upraven-i-nadzoren-odbor at sparkasse.mk vs za-bankata/... at nlb.mk).

negative_findings.description: The seed query assumed ProCredit Bank Macedonia lives at procreditbank.com.mk. Search returned no live content there; the bank's operating domain is pcb.mk (pages /about.nspx, /menadzment.nspx, /akcioneri.nspx).
negative_findings.result_summary: Domain corrected to pcb.mk; no dedicated 'новости'/press-release section was surfaced for ProCredit MK.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector pointed at the seed domain would silently return nothing; and ProCredit MK may have no first-party newsroom at all, forcing reliance on group-level and regulator sources for its leadership moves.

negative_findings.description: For Silk Road Bank and Централна кооперативна банка Скопје no structured, dated press-release index was found — srb.mk exposes only footer 'Медиа'/'Вработување' entries, and ccbank.mk serves documents as loose PDFs under /Upload/ and /ControlPanel/Upload/Sobranie<YYYY>/.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both banks appear to lack a conventional newsroom; the legacy silkroadbank.com.mk NewsDetails.php archive is the only enumerable news series found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leadership and organisational changes at the smaller banks in this cell will be missed by newsroom-style collection and must be caught via MSE filings, NBRM approvals and trade press instead.

negative_findings.description: The NLB Банка press-release archive, when fetched, showed releases dominated by financing initiatives, results, awards and branch refurbishments; no personnel items were visible in the current listing even though a 2025 release on the completed Management Board exists at a known URL.
negative_findings.result_summary: Personnel announcements are real but rare and buried among marketing releases.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Signal-to-noise is low; collection must keyword-filter across the full multi-year archive rather than sampling the front page, or leadership events will be missed.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated 'собрание на акционери' page was located on stb.com.mk, halkbank.mk, ttk.com.mk or srb.mk during this pass; for Стопанска банка the AGM material appears instead as numbered agenda-item PDFs under /media/<id>/ ('точка 9', 'точка 10').
negative_findings.result_summary: AGM disclosure exists but is not consistently exposed as a navigable section across the cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: AGM decisions are the legally required route for supervisory-board elections; without a stable index per bank, collection has to rely on PDF-path discovery or the MSE mirror.

negative_findings.description: Personnel and AGM content in this cell is overwhelmingly Macedonian-only. English versions exist for NLB (/en/), TTK (WebEn.aspx), MSE (/en/) and Silk Road legacy (lang=en), but no English mirror was found for the KB, Sparkasse or CCBank governance/AGM pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-only collection would miss most leadership signals in this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the mandatory-local-language rule empirically and dictates that name matching and keyword filters must be built in Cyrillic first, with transliteration mapping for cross-source linking.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn company pages for the banks in this cell are login-walled for full content and their Terms of Service prohibit automated scraping.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as blocked=true, collection_allowed=false.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A rich hiring and appointment signal must be handled by manual review or a licensed provider rather than a scraper, which affects tooling cost and cadence.

negative_findings.description: The coverage cell assumes the Securities Commission (КХВ) publishes prior-approval decisions for BANK managerial staff. Searches in Macedonian did not support this. КХВ's mandate covers securities-market participants — it grants consent for directors of brokerage houses, investment funds and advisers. Fit-and-proper consent for members of a bank's управен одбор / надзорен одбор is issued by the National Bank (НБРСМ) under Законот за банките and the 'Одлука за издавање согласности'.
negative_findings.result_summary: No КХВ register of bank-manager approvals located; NBRM identified as the correct approving authority.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Monitoring КХВ for bank leadership approvals would produce near-zero yield. The A5 regulatory-approval watch must point at NBRM instead; КХВ remains relevant only for bank-owned brokerage subsidiaries and for issuer-disclosure enforcement.

negative_findings.description: sec.gov.mk was fetched and its navigation enumerated (Регулатива, Учесници, Годишни извештаи, Огласи, Аналитика, Месечни/Квартални извештаи). No section presenting Commission решенија/одлуки as a dated, browsable register was found; the Регулатива page lists rulebook-type 'одлуки' only.
negative_findings.result_summary: KHV decisions are not published as a time-stamped feed on the public site; the annual report appears to be the practical archive.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Removes КХВ as a candidate for a fast, machine-listable approval signal and forces reliance on annual-report backfill or Службен весник.

negative_findings.description: https://www.seinet.com.mk/ returned only the string 'SEI Net' with no navigable content or URL patterns.
negative_findings.result_summary: Unverified, treated as a client-rendered SPA rather than a dead site — deep document links (seinet.com.mk/mk/document/{id}) resolve from the MSE RSS feed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must not depend on scraping the SEINet homepage; use MSE-side RSS/HTML as the index and SEINet only for document retrieval.

negative_findings.description: The issuer page's 'Сите известувања од издавачот' link points to /mk/search/29, but fetching it returned a mixed chronological result list (2007-2026) spanning categories such as block trades and buy-backs, not an issuer-filtered feed. The meaning of the numeric path segment and any date/category query parameters could not be determined from the rendered page.
negative_findings.result_summary: MSE search URL grammar only partially reverse-engineered.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Historical backfill of 'Промени во органите на управување' filings needs this endpoint (or the announcement archive) mapped properly; RSS only carries a recent window.

negative_findings.description: MSE offers /en/ paths and English category slugs appear in announcement URLs ('Changes-in-management-bodies'), but no evidence was found that issuers file the substantive Macedonian PDF in English.
negative_findings.result_summary: English is a navigation veneer; the disclosure content itself is Macedonian.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any English-only collection pipeline would miss the actual content of every filing; mk-language NLP is mandatory for this cell.

negative_findings.description: nbrm.mk (National Bank of RNM) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to WebFetch on the payment-system-operators register URL; the same defence is assumed for the e-money register and licensing pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Register pages are indexed by search engines and clearly live, but not retrievable by plain fetch. Treated as bot-defended-but-live, NOT dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most authoritative list of licensed PIs/EMIs and payment-system operators in this cell needs a headless-browser or header-spoofing collector, otherwise the actor map will silently go stale.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated MK 'people moves' / appointments column covering non-bank payments companies was found in either mk or en searches.
negative_findings.result_summary: Leadership news for KIBS/CaSys/PSPs appears only sporadically and incidentally across faktor.mk, bankarstvo.mk, ecommerce.mk interviews and LinkedIn.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leadership-move detection for this cell must be reconstructed from Central Registry filings plus scattered media, not from a single feed — raises collection cost and latency.

negative_findings.description: Public sources disagree on who currently leads КаСис АД Скопје: one source names Лидија Вучидолова-Богоевска as general director, another names Филомена Пљаковска Аспровска as CEO/president of the management board.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search-snippet-level conflict; not resolved in this scouting pass and not to be treated as fact.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that this cell needs a registry-grounded (Central Registry) verification step rather than media-derived names.

negative_findings.description: The CaSys corporate domain (casys.com.mk) was inferred from company listings rather than returned directly by a search result in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded with lowered confidence; must be resolved by the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A core actor's primary site must not be assumed; a wrong domain would silently drop the biggest processor from collection.

negative_findings.description: No Albanian-language (sq) MK payments-sector source was surfaced, despite Albanian being a major MK language; the run scope specified mk+en only.
negative_findings.result_summary: Portalb.mk and similar sq-language MK outlets were not searched in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: PSP/fintech hiring aimed at the Albanian-speaking labour market (Tetovo/Gostivar/Struga) may be invisible to a mk+en-only collector.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn is the richest real-time source of MK payments leadership and hiring signal but is login-walled and its ToS forbids scraping.
negative_findings.result_summary: Company pages and executive posts for CaSys/KIBS/Paysera/Iute were visible in search snippets only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated collection is not legally available; budget for manual analyst review or a licensed vendor feed.

negative_findings.description: No Visa press release, MK-media report, or vendor page was found naming a Visa country manager or group country manager specifically for North Macedonia, nor a Visa Skopje representative office.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned only CEMEA-level appointments (regional president, sub-region creation) and unrelated travel-visa results; the SEE grouping appears to be covered from a broader CIS/SEE group-country-manager role rather than an MK-specific one.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Visa's MK ownership must be inferred from CEMEA sub-region structure and event/speaker evidence rather than from an appointment announcement, so the collector needs indirect resolution logic for Visa that it does not need for Mastercard.

negative_findings.description: The English term 'Visa' collides catastrophically with travel/immigration visas for North Macedonia.
negative_findings.result_summary: The seed query 'Visa country manager North Macedonia Western Balkans appointment' returned almost exclusively German/Schengen visa-application content plus one World Bank country-manager item; zero payments-scheme results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any automated collection for the Visa actor must force disambiguating tokens (Visa Inc., Visa CEMEA, Visa Europe, payments, card scheme) or restrict to visa.com and payments trade domains, otherwise the channel is pure noise.

negative_findings.description: No MK-specific or Balkans-specific regional director/country hire was found for Diebold Nixdorf or NCR Atleos.
negative_findings.result_summary: Results were confined to global leadership pages, the NCR split into Voyix/Atleos, and generic ATM-vendor comparisons; no Balkans or MK country role surfaced in either English or Macedonian searching.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For ATM vendors the MK account map cannot be built from personnel news; it will have to come from tender/procurement records, partner listings, and LinkedIn, which changes the collection design for this actor group.

negative_findings.description: No North Macedonia country lead, market lead, or expansion hire was found for Revolut, Wise, or MoneyGram.
negative_findings.result_summary: Revolut coverage was Western-Europe recruitment; Wise coverage was global EMEA platform appointments; MoneyGram returned nothing MK-relevant. Western Union has an MK market site but no named MK manager was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These actors currently look like a genuine white space rather than a collection failure - which is itself the signal: no dedicated MK team implies no imminent MK market entry from these players.

negative_findings.description: No MK-facing appointment or country-lead news was found for Nexi, Worldline, BPC, or OpenWay.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned only corporate/comparison pages and generic bank listings for North Macedonia; no MK-scoped personnel or org item for any of the four.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These vendors may reach MK only through partners or not at all; the collector should down-prioritise their newsrooms and instead watch MK bank RFP/tender output for their names.

negative_findings.description: Macedonian-language transliterations exist and work for some actors but not others.
negative_findings.result_summary: Мастеркард, АССЕКО СЕЕ/АСЕЕ and Принтек all returned real MK-language hits. No established Macedonian transliteration was found in use for Diebold Nixdorf, NCR Atleos, Worldline, Nexi, BPC or OpenWay - MK media appear to use the Latin form or not cover them at all.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language monitoring will systematically miss these vendors unless the collector also runs Latin-script vendor names against MK-domain sources.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn is the highest-value channel for this cell but is the least collectable.
negative_findings.result_summary: The only evidence of a Printec Group Country Lead based in North Macedonia came from a LinkedIn profile surfaced in search results; direct programmatic access is authwalled and prohibited by ToS.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's core hypothesis - that vendor country appointments appear on LinkedIn before anywhere else - is supported, but acting on it requires manual analyst review or a licensed data provider, not scraping.

negative_findings.description: None of the URLs listed in this slice were fetched and confirmed live by this agent; all are search-result-derived.
negative_findings.result_summary: Discovery was performed via web search only. No liveness or robots.txt check was performed, and no source here should be treated as verified reachable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must resolve every URL before these enter the source register; failures should be treated as hypotheses, not dead sources.

negative_findings.description: The cell brief named 'Rabota.mk' as a target board. Searches in both mk and en did not surface a live vacancy portal at that domain; search engines instead returned kariera.mk, vraboti.se, apliciraj.mk and the government e-rabota.av.gov.mk. The likely intended source is either e-rabota.av.gov.mk (AVRSM) or a defunct/renamed board.
negative_findings.result_summary: No evidence of an active rabota.mk job board recovered. Not fetched directly, so this is a hypothesis, not a verdict that the domain is dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A named seed source that does not exist would silently create a false sense of coverage; the recall it was meant to provide must be reallocated to kariera.mk / vraboti.se / apliciraj.mk.

negative_findings.description: Targeted searches for MK bank vacancies explicitly naming 'instant payments', 'ISO 20022', SEPA migration or instant-payments project/programme manager roles returned no actual job postings — only macro context (NBRSM/KIBS instant-payment scheme, SEPA ICT accession March 2025) and unrelated Skopje project-manager ads.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero vacancy hits on the highest-value programme keywords via general web search, in both English and Macedonian phrasing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is the single most valuable signal type in the cell. Its absence from search-engine indexes strongly implies such ads exist only inside the boards' own search UIs and bank career pages, where crawler indexing is poor — meaning the collection design must query the portals' internal search directly rather than rely on web search.

negative_findings.description: No settled Macedonian-language vacancy vocabulary was recovered for several core payments concepts: 'ISO 20022' and 'instant payments' appear to be used untranslated or as ad-hoc phrasings ('инстант плаќања', 'итни плаќања'), and no MK-language ad using them was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed mk terms exist and were used successfully for AML ('спречување на перење пари и финансирање тероризам'), payment operations ('одделение за платен промет'), cards ('картично работење'), and payments specialist ('специјалист за плаќања'); no verified mk term set for ISO 20022 / instant payments / fraud / core banking.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword-based collection will systematically under-detect exactly the programme roles the cell exists to find. The glossary must be extended empirically from harvested ad bodies rather than assumed.

negative_findings.description: AVRSM's vacancy search (e-rabota.av.gov.mk/OglasSearch.aspx) is an ASP.NET WebForms page driven by postbacks and ViewState rather than GET parameters, so results are not addressable by URL and are largely invisible to search engines.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search-engine results surfaced only the search form entry point and the user manual PDF, never an individual vacancy record.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The one mandatory-disclosure vacancy register in scope cannot be collected by simple HTTP fetching; budget for headless-browser automation or it will be silently dropped from the pipeline.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn is the only located source that covers leadership moves and title changes for MK banks and PSPs, but its content is login-gated and its ToS forbid automated collection.
negative_findings.result_summary: Company pages (KIBS AD) and a Komercijalna Banka vacancy post were visible in search results, but systematic collection is not permissible by automation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'leadership moves' topic in the run scope has no automatable source in this cell; it must be served by manual analyst review or by a different cell (press releases, NBRSM notifications, trade media).

negative_findings.description: General web search cannot retrieve individual LinkedIn 'new role' / 'excited to join' member posts for MK banking. Queries in both EN and MK returned company pages, Wikipedia and news, never a member-level announcement post.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero member-post hits across the EN seed query and the MK equivalent; LinkedIn member posts and profiles are largely excluded from public search indexes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The core hypothesis of this cell — that individuals announce moves before institutions do — is likely true, but the signal is NOT reachable by open web search. Collection must run inside LinkedIn (logged-in manual review, saved searches/alerts, or a licensed LinkedIn data product), not via crawlers.

negative_findings.description: There is no established Macedonian-language idiom equivalent to the English 'excited to join' / 'thrilled to announce' LinkedIn genre that surfaced in results.
negative_findings.result_summary: MK-language queries using нова позиција / ново назначување returned corporate governance pages, bank vacancy notices and trade-press appointment articles — institutional records, not self-reported posts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: MK banking professionals appear to post such announcements in English even for MK roles, or not at all. Query design for this cell should lean on English announcement idioms plus MK institution names, and MK-language terms should instead be pointed at the institutional layer (Оглас за избор на Директор, именуван, Управен одбор).

negative_findings.description: No evidence found of a ManpowerGroup / Manpower franchise operating in North Macedonia, despite it being named in the cell brief.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches naming Manpower alongside Skopje recruitment returned DEKRA Arbeit Macedonia, vrabotuvanje.com, headhunting.mk, Motivi and the state Employment Agency — no Manpower MK entity.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief's assumed actor list should be corrected: the MK staffing layer is DEKRA + local boutiques + the job boards, not the global staffing majors. Do not create a Manpower MK source record.

negative_findings.description: No MK executive-search firm was observed publishing named placement announcements ('we placed X as CFO of Y').
negative_findings.result_summary: ESC Macedonia, headhunting.mk, InHunt World MK and Motivi present service descriptions only; no public placement track record was visible from search-level inspection.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'recruiter announces the placement' pathway is weaker in MK than in larger markets — confidentiality norms dominate. Expect recruiter sources to yield DEMAND signals (open mandates) rather than confirmed appointments; weight them accordingly.

negative_findings.description: Could not confirm dedicated LinkedIn company pages for several relevant institutions (Halkbank AD Skopje, Sparkasse Banka Skopje, Silk Road Bank, Stopanska Banka, Komercijalna banka, Payten Skopje entity) from search-level evidence.
negative_findings.result_summary: These were referenced only via Wikipedia, third-party data aggregators, or global group pages; no MK-specific LinkedIn URL was surfaced by search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Pages very likely exist but are not search-visible. They are a coverage gap, not an absence — resolve by searching inside LinkedIn rather than recording them as non-existent.

negative_findings.description: No MK business outlet in this cell was observed to run a dedicated, structured 'people moves / appointments' column analogous to a Western 'Movers & Shakers' rubric. Appointment stories appear as ordinary news items scattered through economy/banking categories.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches across Kapital, Faktor, Sloboden Pecat, Nezavisen, Pari and Bankarstvo returned individual appointment articles but no standing personnel rubric or tag page dedicated to executive moves.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection cannot rely on a single high-yield feed per outlet; A5 must run keyword-filtered crawls over broad economy sections, which raises noise and cost and makes recall dependent on glossary completeness.

negative_findings.description: Three cell-seed outlets — Biznis Vesti (biznisvesti.mk), Fokus (fokus.mk) and Ekonomija i Biznis (ekonomijaibiznis.mk) — did not surface with a confirmed live article URL in any query run in this pass; only encyclopedic/second-hand references appeared for Ekonomija i Biznis.
negative_findings.result_summary: Targeted mk queries naming these domains returned results from other outlets instead. No fetch was attempted, so this is a hypothesis of low search visibility, NOT evidence the sites are dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are named in the coverage cell, so leaving them unresolved would look like coverage that does not exist. They must go to the deterministic liveness pass before being scored as usable.

negative_findings.description: The explicit mk query on banking-sector reorganisation and layoffs returned only regulator and encyclopedic material (NBRM banking-system pages, Wikipedia), not media reporting on redundancies at MK banks.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query 'банкарски сектор Македонија реорганизација отпуштања вработени kapital.mk' produced zero media articles about layoffs or restructuring headcount in the MK banking sector.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Either MK banks genuinely shed staff quietly without media pickup, or the local vocabulary for it differs (e.g. 'технолошки вишок', 'рационализација', 'намалување на бројот на вработени'). Both readings mean the layoff/organisation-change branch of A5 is currently under-instrumented for MK.

negative_findings.description: Albanian-language searching found MK appointment journalism in abundance, but essentially all confirmed examples concerned public institutions and utilities (health fund, electronic-communications agency, municipal enterprise, fire service) rather than commercial banks.
negative_findings.result_summary: No Albanian-language article about a commercial-bank executive appointment in North Macedonia was surfaced in this pass, despite using the correct terms (emërimi, drejtor i ri, drejtor ekzekutiv, bankë).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Suggests MK Albanian-language media cover the political-appointment beat far more than the private banking beat; A5 should therefore not expect the Albanian layer to duplicate bank-CEO coverage, but should use it for state-linked financial institutions and for the Albanian-market retail/fintech angle.

negative_findings.description: No outlet in this cell was observed to expose a documented API, sitemap-based archive index, or explicit RSS endpoint in the results returned.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only human-facing category pages and paginated archives were observed (e.g. portalb.mk/category/maqedoni/page/491/, bankarstvo.mk/category/banki/, slobodenpecat.mk/category/vesti/ekonomija/).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must assume HTML crawling with pagination handling and per-site parsers; budget accordingly and probe /feed/, /rss, /sitemap.xml on each domain during the technical pass.

negative_findings.description: OTP Group was named in the cell scope, but searching for an OTP subsidiary in North Macedonia found none.
negative_findings.result_summary: OTP's SEE expansion covered Serbia, Croatia, Slovenia, Montenegro and Albania; SocGen's MK unit Ohridska Banka went to Steiermärkische Sparkasse, not OTP. Current MK bank lists show no OTP entity.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Monitoring OTP's group newsroom for MK leadership news would be wasted effort unless OTP enters the market; keep it only as an M&A-watch source.

negative_findings.description: No Steiermärkische Sparkasse or Erste Group ad-hoc release announcing a specific Sparkasse Bank Makedonija management board appointment was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Graz press releases found cover the 2019 Ohridska Banka acquisition and 2021 merger; board names (Bishev, Alicevic, Nedanoska) surfaced only via aggregators, not a parent release.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: For the Erste/Steiermärkische leg, MK appointments may only be announced locally or via NBRM consent, so the parent feed alone will under-detect; collection must pair sparkasse.at with sparkasse.mk and NBRM.

negative_findings.description: No KAP/Halkbank TR disclosure specifically naming a Halkbank AD Skopje general-manager appointment was retrievable through search.
negative_findings.result_summary: KAP issuer page and Halkbank's özel durum açıklamaları index exist and are the right feeds, but recent hits were capital-increase/public-offering items; the Bilal Sucubaşı departure surfaced via secondary reporting only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: KAP is JS-heavy and poorly indexed by general search; it must be polled directly rather than discovered via search engines.

negative_findings.description: Search snippets returned an outdated owner for Silk Road Bank AD Skopje (Alpha Bank AE, Athens).
negative_findings.result_summary: Corroborating searches confirm Alpha Bank sold the MK unit to Swiss Silk Road Capital AG (announced 2016), after which it was renamed Silk Road Bank.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ownership metadata in aggregators and directories is unreliable for small MK banks; parent-mapping must be re-verified against NBRM and the bank's own site.

negative_findings.description: No BSE-Sofia X3News filing from Central Cooperative Bank AD about management changes at ЦКБ АД Скопје was retrieved.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed the ~87.35% holding and the 2008 Silex Bank renaming, plus Bulgarian parent management names, but no dated subsidiary-governance filing surfaced via search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: X3News/BSE-Sofia must be queried directly by issuer code rather than via web search; otherwise this ownership leg stays uncovered.

negative_findings.description: No IFC or EIB document naming a board nominee/director at a specific MK bank was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: EBRD/IFC involvement is documented at the shareholding level (ProCredit Holding stake transfer; historical Stopanska Banka stake with NBG) but individual nominee directors were not disclosed in retrievable sources.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: IFI board influence in MK banks will have to be inferred from PSDs, annual reports and NBRM consents rather than from direct IFI personnel announcements.

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/API/structured feed identified for Службен весник, Собрание decisions, or NBRNM press releases; all candidates are HTML/PDF scrape targets.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build snapshot-and-diff collectors with stable content hashing; investigate whether slvesnik.com.mk exposes a per-issue index page that can be enumerated by issue number.

coverage_gaps.description: Mid-level regulator personnel (directorate heads for supervision, payment systems, fintech/oversight, AML at NBRNM; unit heads at KHV) are not systematically published anywhere found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add LinkedIn company-page monitoring for НБРСМ / Народна банка and КХВ, plus NBRNM annual report author/speaker lists and conference agendas (e.g. Macedonian Stock Exchange annual conference), as indirect identity sources. Note this crosses into other cells' territory — coordinate.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language (sq) sources were not searched, although Albanian is an official language in RNM and several regulator officeholders and outlets (e.g. Albanian-language media) publish appointment news in Albanian.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the glossary to sq ('Banka Popullore e Republikës së Maqedonisë së Veriut', 'guvernator', 'zëvendësguvernator', 'emërim') and add Albanian-language MK outlets to the next scouting pass.

coverage_gaps.description: No historical succession dataset (governors, vice-governors, Council members with mandate start/end dates) was located in machine-readable form.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Construct a mandate-expiry calendar from the 7-year Council mandate rule (Art. 49, Law on the NBRM) plus gazette decision dates; this converts a reactive feed into a predictive one.

coverage_gaps.description: The President of RNM formally proposes the NBRNM Governor to the Assembly, but the presidency's own publication channel (pretsedatel.mk) was not directly examined in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout the President's office press/decisions pages as an additional earliest-signal channel for governor nominations.

coverage_gaps.description: The full list of licensed banks, savings houses, payment institutions and e-money institutions (with EMBS numbers) was not enumerated in this pass because the NBRSM register pages returned 403 to direct fetch.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-fetch NBRSM registers (banks, savings houses, payment institutions, EMIs, payment system operators) with a browser-grade client and extract name+EMBS to seed the CRM watchlist.

coverage_gaps.description: Exact fee schedule and licensing terms for CRM current-status/history certificates and for the Интернет дистрибутивен систем were not confirmed beyond a reported ~5,000 MKD minimum prepayment.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Obtain the official CRM tariff (тарифник) and the IDS usage agreement; price a monthly monitoring plan for the licensed-entity population.

coverage_gaps.description: Run languages were mk and en only; North Macedonia has substantial official Albanian-language publication, and some register/gazette material and issuer announcements appear in Albanian.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Albanian search terms (regjistri qendror, ndryshim i drejtuesit, bordi mbikëqyrës, Gazeta Zyrtare) in a follow-up pass.

coverage_gaps.description: The CRM Регистар на годишни сметки (annual accounts register) was not examined; bank annual accounts and annual reports filed there disclose board composition and headcount, a secondary but legally compelled record.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test the annual-accounts register for banks/PIs and assess whether filed reports include board rosters and employee counts.

coverage_gaps.description: NBRSM prior-consent decisions for bank board appointments are legally required but no public list of issued consents was located in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check NBRSM annual reports and file an FOI request via slobodenpristap.mk for a list of consents issued per year; this would give the earliest signal in the chain.

coverage_gaps.description: MBA's Комисии (commissions) and SKIBOR panel subpages were identified via site navigation but not fetched, so committee chairs and panel bank composition remain unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Directly crawl the mba.mk /za-nas/ subtree and the SKIBOR section to extract commission names, chairs and member banks; this is the single highest-value unresolved item in the cell.

coverage_gaps.description: The Chamber of North Macedonia's ~15 associations, ~12 asocijacii and ~38 groups were confirmed to exist as a numbered URL space but only two were inspected (ICT id=5, non-bank financial id=25; id=14 also surfaced).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate /mk/home/zdruzenijainfo/{1..40} and /mk/home/grupacii/{1..60}, capture officer names per section, and build a chamber-wide officer table as the baseline for change detection.

coverage_gaps.description: AmCham's 130+ member roster and FIC's ~40-company membership were confirmed to exist as pages but were not fetched, so no actual member names were captured beyond board officers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch amcham.mk/membership/members-list/ and locate FIC's members page, extracting company names and membership tiers into the actor map.

coverage_gaps.gap_type: sector not covered by this cell's sources
coverage_gaps.description: No insurance-sector association (e.g. an association of insurance companies or insurance brokers) was confirmed; only the regulator ISA/АСО (aso.mk) surfaced. Since the run scope is sector=both, an insurance-side association may exist and be unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated mk-language pass on 'Асоцијација на осигурителни брокери', 'Национално биро за осигурување' and ISA's list of supervised entities to close the insurance-association gap.

coverage_gaps.description: Association governance changes (new board, new secretary) must be filed with the Central Registry of North Macedonia, but no registry-based verification path for association officers was explored in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Investigate crm.com.mk / the Central Registry's associations-and-foundations register as an authoritative, date-stamped confirmation layer for association board changes, independent of what the associations choose to publish.

coverage_gaps.description: Association secretariat hiring (analysts, project officers, EU-project staff such as MBA's MiCreS project) is not published on any confirmed source; only elected officers are visible.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Monitor association LinkedIn pages and MK job boards for postings attributed to MBA, MASIT, AmCham and the Chamber; treat this as a low-yield but unique channel for the 'jobs/hiring' topic within this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: The ESJN portal's own search interface, its CPV filtering, and whether anonymous users can browse concluded-contract detail pages (vs. needing a subscribed account) were not established, because the portal 403'd.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a headless-browser probe of e-nabavki.gov.mk Public Access: map the notice search form, CPV filter parameters, pagination and any CSV/Open Data export endpoint; document whether an account is required.

coverage_gaps.description: Municipal and public-enterprise contracting authorities (општини, ЈП Водовод, ЕСМ, Пошта на Северна Македонија, ФЗОМ, ПИОМ) were not individually enumerated, yet they are the volume buyers of card acceptance and e-payment collection.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract the full ESJN institution list (InstitutionGridData) as the authoritative contracting-authority registry, then prioritise entities with citizen-facing collections; add Пошта and the health/pension funds as named watch targets.

coverage_gaps.description: IFI procurement routes outside the EU (EBRD, World Bank, EIB) that fund MK financial-sector and PFM work were referenced only in passing; their own procurement notice boards were not scouted.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout EBRD Procurement Notices, World Bank Procurement (STEP/Business Opportunities) and EIB for MK financial-sector/PFM contracts and their consultant selection notices, which publish shortlisted firms and expert requirements.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language coverage was not attempted, although Albanian is an official language and municipal contracting authorities in western MK publish in it.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add sq glossary terms (prokurimi publik, njoftim per kontrate te lidhur, sherbime bankare, terminale POS) and re-run discovery against municipal sites and the portal's Albanian interface.

coverage_gaps.description: No validated CPV code list for the payments/banking scope was assembled, and MK CPV usage was not observed on any real notice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Derive the working CPV set empirically from ESJN/TED award data for MK (banking/financial services, payment terminals, transaction processing software, IT consultancy) rather than assuming the EU codes are applied consistently.

coverage_gaps.description: Seavus, ULTRA, Neotel, Semos and the Netcetera-adjacent Skopje payments houses have not been mapped to their own careers pages, client pages or MASIT profiles.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run one targeted pass per company: fetch the MASIT profile (stable slug pattern /en/members-en/{slug}/ and /members-mk/{slug}/), then the company's own /careers, /clients, /references and /news paths in both MK and EN.

coverage_gaps.description: Leadership-move detection for vendors depends almost entirely on LinkedIn, which is login-walled and ToS-restricted for automated collection; no open substitute was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Establish a compliant route — licensed people-data provider, or a disciplined manual analyst review cadence of the ~10 vendor company pages — and record it as the designated leadership-move channel rather than leaving A5 leadership coverage to chance.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language sources were not searched at all; a significant share of MK IT and banking employment activity (Tetovo, Gostivar, Struga, and Albanian-language business media) is invisible to mk+en-only coverage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an Albanian query set (punësim, inxhinier, zgjidhje pagesash, banka, teknologji informative) and Albanian-language MK outlets to the next pass, even though the run scope specifies mk+en.

coverage_gaps.description: No authoritative registry source is yet wired in: the Central Registry of the Republic of North Macedonia (Централен регистар на РСМ) would give incorporation, activity code, management (управител) and annual-account data for every vendor in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and assess the Central Registry's public search and any open-data/annual-accounts service as a first-class source; it converts unverifiable vendor marketing claims into registry-grade facts and independently detects leadership changes.

coverage_gaps.description: The 'bank PDF supplier fingerprint' technique was identified but only sampled on Stopanska banka and CCB; it has not been applied systematically across all MK banks.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a vendor-name dictionary and run a scheduled PDF harvest + text-match across every MK bank's digital-banking, general-conditions and security pages; diff editions to detect supplier switches.

coverage_gaps.description: International scheme and vendor partner-locators (Mastercard/Visa partner directories, Microsoft/Oracle/Temenos/Finastra partner finders) were not searched for MK-registered partners.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query each major platform vendor's partner-locator filtered to North Macedonia; these directories are the standard mechanism by which integrator-to-platform (and by inference bank-platform) relationships become public.

coverage_gaps.description: The eCommerce Conference speaker archives were identified from search results but individual speaker pages were not fetched, so the exact schema (does each card carry title + employer + year?) is inferred, not confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch https://ecommerceconference.mk/2021/en/speaker/ and the 2019/2020/2022 equivalents, plus the current edition, and confirm field structure before building the person-title timeseries.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language (sq) event and academic sources in North Macedonia were not searched — a material share of MK banking/fintech staff and institutions (e.g. Tetovo/SEEU, Albanian-language business media) communicate in sq, and the run's language scope (mk, en) excludes it.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Flag to run owner: either extend language scope to sq or record permanent blind spot for Albanian-language conference and academic rosters (SEEU, UT Tetovo, Portalb.mk events).

coverage_gaps.description: Individual bank 'awards & recognitions' and 'press/events' pages (Komercijalna, NLB, Stopanska, Halkbank, ProCredit, Sparkasse, Silk Road, Centralna kooperativna, TTK) were not enumerated in this cell, although they publish which executive represented the bank at which conference.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the ten MK bank domains from nbrm.mk/banki.nspx and add their news/press sections as A5 speaker-mention sources.

coverage_gaps.description: Video channels were not covered: NBRNM's YouTube channel and MBA/conference organisers post full panel recordings whose titles and descriptions state speaker names and roles, often when no agenda PDF survives.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add the NBRNM YouTube channel and organiser channels as a secondary A5 stream; harvest video titles/descriptions rather than transcribing.

coverage_gaps.description: Conference sites routinely delete prior-year speaker pages when a new edition launches (the AETM site already splits editions across /2019/, /2020/, /2021/ and a 2022 subdomain). Title-drift analysis depends on those historical snapshots.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Immediately capture web-archive snapshots for all known edition URLs and mirror speaker pages locally at first collection.

coverage_gaps.description: The richest single channel for speaker/title signal (LinkedIn pages of MBA, KIBS, banks and conference organisers) is auth-walled and ToS-restricted for automated collection.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat LinkedIn as analyst-only/manual or licensed-API; do not build a scraper. Compensate with the open conference and association sources listed here.

coverage_gaps.description: СФОМ's per-bank member organisations, collective-agreement documents and news archive were only summarised at one level; individual bank union branches (e.g. синдикална организација при Комерцијална банка) were not enumerated with URLs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl sfom.mk structure/member pages and the news category in a browser context, extract the full member-organisation list and any collective-agreement PDFs, and register each bank-level union branch as its own actor.

coverage_gaps.description: The NBRSM report and indicator pages, which carry employees/branches per bank, could not be fetched or their document URLs enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a browser-based fetch of the two NBRSM index pages, enumerate quarterly report PDFs and indicator XLSX links, and build a per-quarter extraction of the 'вработени' and 'деловни единици/експозитури' tables.

coverage_gaps.description: No court/registry layer covered: Централен регистар на РСМ (management-board and authorised-person changes per bank) and labour-court judgments on dismissals were not searched in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a pass on crm.com.mk (Central Registry) filings and sudovi.mk / Судска мрежа judgment search for labour disputes naming banks, in Macedonian.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language labour and banking coverage (portalb.mk, koha.mk) was not searched, despite a substantial Albanian-speaking banking workforce and Halkbank/TEB-type institutions with Albanian-language communication.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sq-language pass ('sindikata e punëtorëve të bankave', 'mbyllja e degëve bankare', 'shkurtime vendesh pune banka') across portalb.mk and koha.mk.

coverage_gaps.description: Employer-side and job-market signals of organisation change (Агенција за вработување на РСМ vacancy statistics, vraboti.mk / pazaranarabota.mk bank job postings, LinkedIn bank headcount pages) were not covered in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a hiring-signal layer: monitor bank career pages and MK job boards for volume and role-mix shifts (branch roles down, IT/ops-centre roles up) as a leading indicator of back-office centralisation.

coverage_gaps.description: No verified enumeration of archived 'Управен и Надзорен одбор' / management page URLs for the ~13 MK banks, because web.archive.org egress is blocked for this agent.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated CDX enumeration pass from an unrestricted environment across kb.mk, stb.com.mk, nlb.mk, sparkasse.mk, halkbank.com.mk, unibank.mk, procreditbank.com.mk, ttk.com.mk, capitalbank.com.mk, silkroadbank.com.mk, razvojnabanka.mk, and nbrm.mk, filtering paths on (odbor|uprav|nadzor|rakovodstvo|management|about|za-nas|za-bankata), then diff name lists between consecutive captures.

coverage_gaps.description: No international executive-search / HR-market source found for MK banking (no regional headhunter reports, no LinkedIn-derived aggregators, no salary/hiring trackers) covering the 'jobs' and 'hiring' topics as opposed to top-level 'leadership moves'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend a later cell to professional-network and job-board aggregators (LinkedIn company pages of MK banks, vrabotuvanje.com.mk, pazaridaskrvi/mojrabota equivalents) and to regional HR consultancies; this cell's international monitors cover boards only, never rank-and-file hiring.

coverage_gaps.description: The two highest-yield English sources for this cell (SeeNews, The Banker) and both major rating agencies are paywalled or login-walled; only headlines and syndicated mirrors are freely retrievable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Budget for a SeeNews subscription (or at minimum headline-feed access) and register institutional accounts with Fitch/Moody's; in the interim, systematically use the TradingView/Reuters syndication mirror and mk-language republishers as free substitutes.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-sector (non-bank) actors — CaSys, KIBS, Klikni Kupi, Nayax and card-scheme country managers — have no identified international monitor that reports their personnel changes; only one-off market-entry stories were found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a targeted pass on payments-infrastructure operators' own press pages (casys.com.mk, kibs.mk) and on NBRNM's payment-infrastructure pages, plus Nayax/Visa/Mastercard regional press releases naming MK country leads.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language coverage (sq) was not searched — a significant share of MK banking-sector reporting and of the relevant labour pool is Albanian-language, and TEB/Halkbank-linked networks in particular are covered by sq-language outlets.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an sq-language query set (bankë, drejtor i përgjithshëm, bordi drejtues, bordi mbikëqyrës, emërohet) against portalb.mk, koha.mk and Albanian regional outlets in a follow-up cell.

coverage_gaps.description: No first-party newsroom or management page was confirmed this pass for Централна кооперативна банка Скопје, Silk Road Bank, or ТТК Банка at the level of named Управен/Надзорен одбор rosters.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Direct-crawl ccbank.mk, srb.mk and ttk.com.mk sitemaps in a follow-up pass with mk terms 'органи на управување', 'раководство', 'корпоративно управување'; fall back to their MSE issuer pages and NBRM approval notices.

coverage_gaps.description: NBRM (Народна банка на РСМ) governor approvals of management/supervisory board appointments were referenced indirectly (Sparkasse SB re-appointments approved by the Governor) but the regulator's own approval notices were not scouted — they sit outside this cell but are the confirming leg for every appointment found here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure a sibling cell covers nbrm.mk 'соопштенија' and licensing/approval decisions, and cross-link it to these first-party sources.

coverage_gaps.description: Only NLB (2016–2026 year tabs), Sparkasse (numbered AGM sessions) and the Silk Road legacy site (NewsDetails.php?News=N) offer an enumerable historical archive; the .nspx sites (kb.mk, pcb.mk, halkbank.mk) show no obvious pagination depth from the landing pages.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe pagination parameters and check Wayback Machine coverage for kb.mk/za-nas-novosti.nspx and halkbank.mk/novosti to build a multi-year baseline of leadership changes.

coverage_gaps.description: Careers pages were confirmed for KB, STB, NLB, Halkbank corporate and Silk Road, but not for Sparkasse, ProCredit, UNIBanka, TTK or CCBank — leaving the 'jobs/hiring' topic unevenly covered across the cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a targeted mk pass on 'вработување'/'кариера'/'слободни работни места' scoped per remaining domain, and complement with employer-filtered queries on vrabotuvanje.com.mk.

coverage_gaps.description: Sparkasse and CCBank serve Cyrillic-percent-encoded .aspx paths and deep /Upload/ PDF folders; TTK is query-string driven; Unibank stores AGM PDFs in space-and-Cyrillic folder names. Generic crawlers will mis-handle these URLs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build per-domain URL normalisation (UTF-8 percent-encoding, space handling) and PDF-first extraction into the collector before scheduling this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Only 7 banks appear on MSE mandatory listing. Foreign-owned banks with no free float (e.g. Halkbank, ProCredit, Sparkasse, Silk Road) have no SEI-NET obligation, so their leadership changes never reach this feed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair this cell with NBRM consent monitoring, Central Registry тековна состојба diffs, and each bank's own 'За банката / Органи на управување' page to cover the unlisted half of the sector.

coverage_gaps.description: The NBRM regime for granting consent to bank board members is documented, but no page listing individual granted consents with dates and names was located within this slice's budget.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted follow-up on nbrm.mk supervision subpages, NBRM press releases, and the NBRM annual supervision report; if nothing exists, log as a structural blind spot and rely on the issuer disclosure as the primary timestamp.

coverage_gaps.description: Службен весник на РСМ (slvesnik.com.mk) was identified as a likely publication venue for regulator decisions but was not searched in this slice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass over Службен весник for NBRM/KHV decisions naming bank officers and statute changes.

coverage_gaps.description: Централен депозитар за хартии од вредност (CSD) was not investigated; it may hold complementary issuer and shareholder-event records.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout cdhv.mk / the CSD portal in a follow-up cell.
